title: What If a Volcano Launched 58,000 Pools Into the Sky?

scenes.text: What if a volcano put 58,000 swimming pools into the sky? One did.
Hunga Tonga's plume rose about 35 miles, a record for the satellite era.
It threw up 146 teragrams of water vapor, enough to fill more than 58,000 Olympic swimming pools.
That was roughly 10 percent of all the water already sitting in the stratosphere.
Most eruptions cool the planet with ash. Water vapor traps heat instead, so scientists expected slight warming.
And it may linger for five to ten years. One eruption, still hanging over your head.

description:
What if a volcano launched 58,000 swimming pools of water into the sky?
Hunga Tonga did in 2022, adding about 10 percent to the stratosphere's water, and it may linger for up to ten years.
